page.overview:
What is Jump Worlds?

The Jump Worlds are a containing various Weekly Shonen Jump series' worlds, including One Piece. First appearing in the Jump Super Stars one-shot, the Jump Worlds would go on to be the primary setting of Jump Force.

In Jump Super Stars, the Jump World visited by Kobayakawa Sena is a large, rocky region. It contains a thick forest where he initially landed, as well as Dr. Mashirito's lab.

In Jump Super Stars, the only known permanent residents of the unnamed Jump World are Dr. Mashirito, Caramel Man #10, and Caramel Man #11. Monkey D. Luffy, Naruto Uzumaki, Goku, Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo, and Aya Toujou also temporarily take up residence in a cave in the Jump World.

Due to the Jump Worlds' nature as a multiverse, each universe contained within it also has its own resident characters.
